name: Validate Impulse Resolution Sequence
description: Validates impulse resolution by testing filtering, resolver dispatch, budget enforcement, and dual-mode formatting

tasks.description: Create test impulses with various relevance scores

config.command:
cat > /tmp/test-impulse-high.txt << 'EOF'
High relevance test content (relevance: 0.85)
This impulse should always be loaded.
EOF
cat > /tmp/test-impulse-low.txt << 'EOF'
Low relevance test content (relevance: 0.3)
This impulse should be skipped.
EOF
cat > /tmp/test-impulse-large.txt << 'EOF'
$(python3 -c 'print("A" * 20000)')
EOF
echo 'Created test impulses'

tasks.description: Load large impulse and verify truncation

prompt.template:
Verify the impulse resolution dispatch chain:

Local resolution result:
{{impulse:local_resolution_result}}

Budget test result:
{{impulse:budget_test_result}}

Validate:
1. Local resolver worked (memo, file, directoryTree, gitDiff)
2. Budget enforcement applied
3. Dispatch order: local → custom → discovery → MCP → fallback

Output JSON validation:
{
  "localResolverWorked": true/false,
  "budgetEnforced": true/false,
  "dispatchChainValid": true/false,
  "passed": true/false
}

config.command: echo 'Testing dual-mode: pointer-mode (metadata) vs content-mode (full content)'
